components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary forward action for product and landing flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #4edea3; color: #003824; font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6ffbbe; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dfe4e0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary action that preserves task hierarchy on dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #3c4a42; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #dfe4e0; font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { border-color: #86948a; background: rgba(223,228,224,0.08); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4edea3; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact surface-backed field for library and catalog search.

narrative.overview: Popcorn Time should feel like settling into a private screening room: dark, calm, and focused on the next story rather than a loud entertainment feed. The interface gives each user an orderly place for a personal collection while making shared tracking feel deliberate and close-knit.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic darkness with an organic green cast rather than neutral black.
Screening Mint reserved for decisive actions, active states, and meaningful progress.
High-legibility Inter typography with compact, confident hierarchy.
Border-led structure and soft ambient elevation for tactile interaction.

rules.name: The Screening Mint Rule
rules.body: Use Screening Mint to communicate selection, progress, and a clear next action. Do not flood an entire screen with it or introduce competing neon accents.

rules.name: The Screen-Readable Rule
rules.body: Keep labels in sentence case and let size and weight, not all-caps, create functional hierarchy.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Base surfaces remain calm and structurally bordered. Reserve ambient elevation for interaction, hierarchy changes, and temporary overlays.

dos: Do use Nocturne Green and Screening Surface to keep media and task content visually calm.
Do reserve Screening Mint for selection, progress, and actions that move a user forward.
Do preserve 8px rounding, sage borders, and sentence-case Inter labels across product workflows.
Do add only soft, diffuse elevation when an element becomes active, interactive, or transient.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a neon entertainment feed or compete with Screening Mint using unrelated bright accents.
Don't hide structure by removing borders from every surface or piling hard shadows onto cards.
Don't use all-caps controls, generic dashboard density, glassmorphism, or exaggerated pill shapes as a substitute for hierarchy.
